config.notes: Page kinds: (1) UBC Graduate School programme pages www.grad.ubc.ca/prospective-students/graduate-degree-programs/<slug> (most read pages, UBC Vancouver graduate programmes): Quick Facts "Tuition (First Year) Domestic: X | International: Y" and Tuition table "Tuition per year ... $dom $intl" (international column second) -> fee; "<Month> <Year> Intake" headings -> intakes; "IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) Overall score requirement : N" -> ielts_overall; "Mode of delivery In person at UBC Vancouver" -> mode, campus. (2) Faculty/department undergraduate pages (music, geog, theatrefilm, linguistics, history, landfood, nursing) carry no fee, intake or IELTS; undergraduate fees, terms and English are on central pages (you.ubc.ca tuition, vancouver.calendar.ubc.ca key dates, you.ubc.ca English language admission standard). Course-based programmes shorter than a year print first-year tuition that may equal the whole-programme fee.
